en-US.description: A command-line tool to run engine vs engine matches in chess.
en-US.name: Fast Chess
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed

New Features
- Added an NDJSON event stream via -events for real-time event tracking. (#1076)
- Added SIGTERM handling, allowing graceful shutdowns similar to SIGINT. (#1075)

Bug Fixes
- Fixed incorrect threefold repetition detection by updating the chess library. (#1074)
- Fixed timeout handling at time control boundaries. (#1066)
- Fixed duration parsing and improved CLI input validation. (#1065, #1057)
- Prevented crashes caused by SIGPIPE when engines terminate unexpectedly. (#1063)
- Fixed compilation issues with Clang, C++23, and libstdc++. (#1070)

Performance & Improvements
- Reduced compile times, including faster test builds. (#1055, #1067)
- Streamlined engine info parsing and consolidated integer parsing logic. (#1058, #1060)
- Expanded the use of fmt for more consistent formatting. (#1056)
- Improved error messages by including option names. (#1068)
- Improved man page formatting and readability. (#1069)
